notes: Semiannual: n=8 periods, stated 3 percent/period, market (effective) 4 percent/period. Issue price = PV(face) + PV(annuity of $6000) at 4 percent = $146138 + $40396 (components rounded separately; exact total $186534.51) = $186535 (93.268 percent of face), a discount of $13465 because the 6 percent stated rate is below the 8 percent market rate. The conversion option is not separated: under U.S. GAAP the convertible bonds are recorded wholly as debt at the issue price, which is why the market rate on similar NONCONVERTIBLE debt (8 percent) is the pricing rate; no equity component or beneficial-conversion amount is recognized, and no entry is made for the conversion feature until holders convert (after two years, 20 shares per $1,000 bond = 4000 shares if all bonds convert). Authorization on January 1, Year 1 requires no journal entry - only issuance does. Interest expense each period = 4 percent of the beginning carrying amount, rounded HALF_UP to whole dollars; cash interest is fixed at $6000; the difference amortizes the discount and raises carrying amount toward face. Period 8 amortization is plugged at $1922 (expense $7922 vs. $7923 unrounded) so carrying amount closes exactly at $200000 and unamortized discount at $0. At December 31, Year 1 the bonds are long-term (mature December 31, Year 4).
